cuts.head: with_body
cuts.outfit: an opaque indigo athletic one-piece swimsuit, with a high neckline, racerback, full-coverage seat and durable contrasting bound seams
cuts.scene: a pine changing pavilion next to a wide river swimming area, with a pale granite path running past the wet steps and a roof that shades the drying benches
cuts.custom: A quiet after-swim walk toward the pavilion, with the water and sunlit stone steps in context. Her carry bag holds her folded everyday clothes.
